Collaboration with the IADB to publish a Technical Note about the Social Communication and Participation Strategy, designed for 2019-2021, for a project in Tacumbú, Paraguay. This strategy aims to promote transparent and straightforward public consultations on housing programs. The publication expects to disseminate the key findings of this strategy to encourage greater social participation in urban planning projects in the region.
